title: Zigzagging light during Fourth of July fireworks
summary: Richard Barth tells of Zigzagging light during Fourth of July fireworks, about around 2000 at park along a wash near Barth's home, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.
place_text: park along a wash near Barth's home

tellings.quote: gave back to me and it goes it starts into a zigzag

plain: A man named Richard Barth, a former guard at a nuclear missile site who says he was abducted by aliens, says that around 2000 he was watching Fourth of July fireworks at a park along a dry creek bed near his home. He says a light there began to move in a zigzag, and he mentions someone named Roger as part of the story. He tells it as one more strange sighting in his life.
